notes.title: An experimental acceleration function has been added
notes.notes: Now you can accelerate at the beginning of the level and when it fails. HTC and Oculus handle press the grip Key of the (right) handle,and index press the （right）handle A key.

notes.title: Sorry, I haven't repaired or updated my game for some time.
notes.notes:
Sorry, I haven't repaired or updated my game for some time.

Recently, I have experienced some troubles and made some choices. Finally, I can only say that I will try to make the game complete.

This is for those who may want to know something more.

The main reason for the trouble is that my small studio has been disbanded, and several recent projects have not been paid as they should, even though we have used legal means. This also led me to lose my main source of income. The good news is that I just found a job a few days ago and now it is in the probation period,It's just that my time to develop games will definitely decrease.

Finally, thank you for your support and understanding.

notes.title: Added a simple level description
notes.notes:
This update adds a simple level description. Now after selecting a level, a new level description page will appear, where you can see the level name and the fastest record.
Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hold Controller added touchline feedback
notes.notes:
An experimental function has been updated this time.
When the player ends the game by touching the line, a red handle will be generated to show the final failure location.

Fixed the player's reaction of touching his hands together before starting.
Touch will turn into normal color after the vibration ends before the beginning.

Now the feedback of failure will become more obvious.
This is the modification I got when I saw some videos and live broadcasts. In some cases, for example, I didn't start the game from the starting point. In two hand mode, I finished with one hand first and then started with the other hand. This is actually the wrong way to play, but the feedback above does not directly indicate that it is wrong, so that players do not know whether they have failed.

I hope this repair can bring you a better game experience. Thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hold Controller supports the index handle now
notes.notes:
Hold Controller  supports the index handle now.
I want to say sorry to the players who use index, Because I didn't have a index handle before.The option that does not support index handle is not found on the option of motion controller.
At the same time, the process of "try again" has been changed. Now clicking "try again" will count down three seconds and directly generate a level.
Finally, thank you for your support.

notes.title: Hold Controller has release as early access experience stage!
notes.notes:
Hello,I'm glad you chose my game!

I have experienced many "first-time" experiences in the past month.After various repeated modifications and reviews, I finally came to the step of early access experience stage. Although the game is relatively simple, I hope you can support me. I hope you can send email or discuss in the community and give me feedback. 

Thanks!
